mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM sys_tenant WHERE 1 = 1 AND code = #{code}

SELECT DISTINCT T.ID, T.REC_VER, T.CODE, T.NAME, T.TYPE, T.STATUS, T.REMARK FROM sys_tenant T LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user stu on T.ID = stu.TENANT_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND T.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND stu.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT T.ID, T.CREATOR, T.CREATE_TIME, T.MODIFIER, T.MODIFY_TIME, T.LOGIC_DEL, T.REC_VER, T.BUILD_IN, T.TENANT_ID, T.CODE, T.`NAME`, T.`TYPE`, T.STATUS, T.REMARK, T.CONTACT_NAME, T.CONTACT_TEL, T.CONTACT_EMAIL, T.ADDRESS, T.BUSINESS_HOURS_FROM FROM SYS_TENANT T LEFT JOIN SYS_TENANT_USER STU ON T.ID = STU.TENANT_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
